messages.subject: fitting bernardinelli specification
parts:
Hello,

I want to fit the bernardinelli[1995] space-time model:

log(theta_ij)=(mu+phi_i)+(beta+delta_i)*t_j    were i stands for space, j for time and phi_i has a BYM specification.

What I want is a prior correlation between random effects, more specific I want the parameter delta_i to depend on phi_i, as bernardinelli specifies 

[delta_i|phi_i,sigma^2]~Normal(gamma phi_i,sigma^2)

How can I do this with INLA. I was thinking to first estimate phi_i in a previous model and then incorporate it to my model, but I'm not sure if that is possible or even if it's correct. 

This is how I define the model without the prior correlation:

formula.ST2_1<- y ~ 1 + f(ID.area,model="bym",graph=Valencia.adj) + year +
  f(ID.area1,year,model="iid")

Can anyone help with this? Thanks in advance!

Adina.

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] fitting bernardinelli specification
parts:
something similar:
The "besag2" specification in INLA does it for the spatially correlated
effect.
For the uncorrelated part you can use them the "iid2d" model.
